sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: While underway, the master reported to Singapore POCC that three perpetrators had boarded the barge from a small boat. After about 20 min, the perpetrators were seen leaving the barge. The crew was unable to determine any loss of property and the crew was not injured. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was initiated to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN's MSTF and Singapore PCG were notified of the incident. Information of the incident was shared with the Indonesian authority.
